description: Previous error log (err-20260626T141212-S7ECTB) proposed 'apostrophe alias ambiguity' as the root cause of the organizer misattribution. David clarified both emails are his — the real failure is treating isOrganizer: true as proof that David created or arranged the event. Exchange sets isOrganizer on the calendar copy belonging to the organizer's account; it does not confirm David was the one who planned or scheduled the event in any meaningful sense.
what_was_wrong: Asserted David organized Movie Night based on isOrganizer: true in the calendar API response.
what_was_right: isOrganizer: true is a calendar object property, not evidence of intent or authorship. Organizer status requires corroboration (sent email, explicit statement, invite trail).
proposed_fix: Never surface 'you organized this' in briefings based solely on isOrganizer: true. Only assert organizer role if corroborated by a sent email or David's explicit statement. Flag isOrganizer events neutrally: 'You are listed as organizer.'
